objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has created fake domains to imitate legitimate venture capital or bank domains.(Citation: 1 - appv) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has acquired domains to host fake skill assessments leading to malware download.(Citation: Microsoft CYBERWARCON NOV 2024) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has registered domains that masquerade as financial institutions and resemble legitimate services.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has also obtained C2 domains to host second-stage malicious payloads.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
